headline: Building the tools that build
narrative: Quiet week in Stockholm, but deep focus on cursor-commands and shipflow. Contributing back to the ecosystem while exploring new sounds—dream pop meets french indie pop. The overcast skies match the heads-down energy.

sections.title: Cursor commands
sections.content: Deep work on cursor-commands and shipflow, with a PR contribution back to the community. 24 commits focused on developer tooling—point-and-click editing for Next.js, agent workflows, and staying in flow. Building the infrastructure that makes building easier.

sections.title: Dream pop meets rap
sections.content: Core taste holding steady: Beach House and dream pop layered with rap from Kanye and A$AP Rocky. New exploration into french indie pop—Videoclub and Parcels adding texture to the usual mix. Tame Impala and Fred again.. keeping the neo-psychedelic and house energy flowing.

sections.title: Quiet week
sections.content: No posts this week, but recent themes around surgical iterations, comparing agents in context, and building with multiple models. The vision remains: making building software easier and more fun.

footer: Overcast Stockholm winter, short days, long focus. Building tools in the quiet hours.
